title: Agent Studio alignment training spec bundle
description: Machine-readable schemas, deterministic alignment rules, and grading rubric for evaluating mission workflow quality. Adapted from Factory Droid alignment-training-spec v1.

notes: Skill definitions are under .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md; features reference skillName only.
Schemas use additionalProperties: true where safe for extensibility.
Schemas use relative $id values resolved from the schemas directory.
